fullSource:
use default

let countries = [
    (country = "UK", city = "London"),
    (country = "US", city = "New York"),
    (country = "US", city = "Birmingham"),
    (country = "UK", city = "Birmingham")
]

let by_city = countries
    |> sort((a, b) => a.city <> b.city)
    |> collect_list()

for row in by_city do
    write_line("{row.country} {row.city}")
od
output:
US Birmingham
UK Birmingham
UK London
US New York
